data.name: Seafields
data.description: Seafields is a UK-based aquaculture carbon-removal company that intercepts, farms, and harvests pelagic Sargassum seaweed using floating AlgaePonix paddocks and SeaClear deflection barriers, primarily deployed in the Caribbean. The company valorises the biomass into biostimulants, bioplastics, and other bio-products, with unsold pulp converted to biochar through partners and long-term plans to bale and sink Sargassum in ocean gyres for permanent carbon sequestration.
